title: Do Vision CIL Methods Transfer to Protein? A Diagnostic Benchmark of Frozen Protein Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.18879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein function annotation operates over an expanding label space, making class-incremental learning (CIL) a natural framework for incorporating newly discovered functions without full retraining. Yet existing CIL methods have been developed largely in vision and have not been systematically evaluated over frozen protein representations. We conduct a controlled benchmark of nine representative CIL methods across five sequence-, structure-, and sequence--structure-based protein encoders and two enzyme function datasets at different scales, while keeping the encoders frozen and evaluation settings consistent across representations. We find that no method transfers reliably across encoders, and that these failures persist across alternative phase constructions. translated_title: 视觉类增量学习方法能否迁移到蛋白质领域？——面向冻结蛋白质编码器的诊断性基准测试
translated_abstract: 摘要：蛋白质功能注释所面对的标签空间不断扩大，这使得类增量学习成为在不进行完全重训的情况下纳入新发现功能的天然框架。然而，现有的类增量学习方法大多是在视觉领域开发的，尚未在冻结的蛋白质表示上进行过系统评估。我们对九种具有代表性的类增量学习方法进行了受控基准测试，涵盖五种基于序列、结构以及序列-结构的蛋白质编码器和两个不同规模的酶功能数据集，同时保持编码器冻结，并确保评估设置在不同表示之间保持一致。我们发现，没有任何一种方法能够可靠地跨编码器迁移，而且这些失败在不同的阶段构建方式下依然存在。诊断分析表明，这种不稳定性源于较弱的基于梯度的稳定性信号、嵌入几何结构中的显著异质性，以及不成立的协方差假设……
tldr: 该论文系统评估了九种视觉领域的类增量学习方法在冻结蛋白质编码器上的表现，发现没有任何方法能可靠地跨编码器迁移，其根源在于梯度稳定性信号弱、嵌入几何异质性大以及协方差假设不成立。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks nine vision-based class-incremental learning methods on frozen protein encoders and finds that none transfer reliably across encoders, due to weak gradient-based stability signals, substantial heterogeneity in embedding geometry, and violated covariance assumptions.
